players.product: descum & reflow systems for advanced packaging

quarterly_data.signal: Revenue mix and positioning per the PSK Group IR book (Aug 2026, as of year-end 2025): PSK Holdings revenue was 92% products, 7% parts/service and 1% other; within products, fluxless Reflow (GENEVA) 62% and Descum (ECOLITE) 33%, with Plasma Source and Hot DI Water making up the small remainder. Regional revenue composition: Reflow 86% Taiwan, 10% Korea, 4% China; Descum 43% Taiwan, 16% Korea, 35% China, 5% other. The company describes GENEVA as the world's first system to mass-produce the fluxless reflow process, supporting plating-bump reflow, re-balling and chip-on-wafer (CoW) bonding applications and providing packaging solutions for HBM and 2.5D packaging; ECOLITE serves descum and surface treatment in wafer-level and panel-level packaging (RDL profile and bump formation). SEMIgear (US) is described as the technology origin of fluxless reflow. R&D expenditure KRW 13,321M in 2025 (KRW 12,081M in 2024) on revenue of KRW 207,764M; 130 employees of whom 49 in R&D at 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025: Reflow (GENEVA) 62% / Descum (ECOLITE) 33% of product sales; products 92% of revenue; Reflow sales 86% Taiwan; Descum 43% Taiwan, 35% China, 16% Korea; R&D KRW 13,321M

quarterly_data.signal: PSK Group capex sites listed in the IR book: the Pangyo R&D Campus (4,544 square meters of land, 41,627 square meters of floor area, investment KRW 82.5 B, completed May 2024) and a new site in the Yongin Semiconductor Cluster General Industrial Complex (Wonsam-myeon, Yongin; 15,412 square meters, floor area ratio of 350% or less, investment amount not disclosed) scheduled for completion in 2028. The group operates 25 sites in 7 countries.
quarterly_data.figure: Yongin Semiconductor Cluster site 15,412 m2, completion 2028 (investment N/A); Pangyo campus KRW 82.5 B (May 2024)

players.product: front-end dry-strip / dry-cleaning (plasma ash and etch) equipment maker; 32.76%-owned associate of PSK Holdings and a related-party buyer of PSK Holdings parts, services and equipment

quarterly_data.signal: PSK Inc. section of the PSK Group IR book (Aug 2026): revenue as of year-end 2025 was 54% products and 46% parts/service; within products Dry Strip (SUPRA, OMNIS etc.) 88% and Dry Cleaning (INTEGER, PRECIA etc.) 12%. Regional composition: Dry Strip 38% Korea, 21% US, 17% Taiwan, 8% China, 16% other; Dry Cleaning (INTEGER) 72% Korea, 28% China; Bevel Etch (PRECIA) 52% Korea, 48% China. The group claims more than 40% worldwide market share and describes itself as the world #1 technology company in dry strip. OMNIS new-hard-mask strip (removal of doped hard masks used as aspect ratios rise with scaling and 3D stacking) lists Micron and Intel as main customers. R&D expenditure KRW 35,728M in 2025 on revenue of KRW 457,213M; 129 researchers of 329 employees.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 product sales: Dry Strip 88% / Dry Cleaning 12%; parts/service 46% of revenue; Dry Strip sales 38% Korea, 21% US; claimed >40% world share; OMNIS customers Micron, Intel

contracts.signal: The PSK Group IR book (Aug 2026) names Micron (with Intel) as a main customer of PSK Inc.'s OMNIS new-hard-mask strip platform, used to remove highly etch-resistant doped hard masks at advanced nodes without damaging underlying oxide / nitride films.
contracts.type: customer relationship (named in company IR deck)
